title: constructing an authored subclass of a foreign class runs the foreign base constructor through an implicit `super(...)`
notes: specification/compatibility.mdx, "Foreign Boundary": "Calling an unannotated foreign runtime value MUST add the checked `panic` case, because JavaScript and TypeScript may throw, reject, or violate a declaration." 09-foreign-calls/foreign-constructor-needs-throws-never pins the direct `new Foreign()`; this pins the spelling that reaches the same constructor with the foreign name nowhere near the `new`. The requirement is charged on the CONSTRUCTION and not on the `extends` clause, and that distinction is load-bearing rather than decorative — see the acceptance case beside this one.
